question: The one-line table A, with one thing changed each. A: status as a dot plus text, no badge. B: progress as a number, no bar. C: compact rows. Which feels right?

variants.label: Status dot
variants.changes: Status badge becomes a colored dot plus plain text ("At risk" in red). Everything else is round-004 A.

variants.label: Progress number
variants.changes: Progress bar removed. Progress is a right-aligned number. Everything else is round-004 A.

variants.label: Compact rows
variants.changes: Row padding drops from 16px to 10px top and bottom. Everything else is round-004 A.
